schema: Observing an upstream commit does not mean Monogatari adopted it. 'integrated' is what the app actually builds against or ported; 'status' says why.

Kotatsu-Redo/Kotatsu-Redo.note: Selective sync only; do not wholesale-merge the divergent app history. 9.8.7 adds signed runtime parser bundles, a community dismissal uploader and a reader animation player: each needs an explicit owner decision.

Kotatsu-Redo/kotatsu-parsers-redo.note: Newer commits move the parser contract classes out of this artifact and publish parsers as a signed runtime bundle; no JitPack build exists for them under the pinned coordinate.

integrated.note: JS contract/runtime port, not the Flutter app

kodjodevf/mangayomi.note: JS Client PUT/DELETE/PATCH routing is already covered by JsHttpShimMethodsTest; the malformed-filter fix concerns Dart-side filter parsing that Monogatari does not perform.
